item.description:

If you open the QR code on them it leads you to a page for a location in North Peckham. This is unhemlmpful as they are in Bermondsey. Please remove them a.s.a.p.

item.title: No.14 St Albans Road NW5 1RD, 18th October
item.description:
The oak tree has overhanging branches over the pavement. It also has thick sap that ends up on the cars parked nearby and beneath it. Often nobody parks there because of it, which is a waste of a parking space, but people do not want their cars damaged. The house garden it is in is a multiple occupancy house and nobody seems to take responsibility for pruning it back. It is right next to their garden fence and that is bulging outward.
